description: Original, scene-first blueprints for the research-backed CJK commercial-world routes. Market origin remains routing metadata; each rendered scene carries one separate diegetic visual provenance and avoids copied UI, crests, silhouettes, characters, and living-ritual reenactment.

scene_blueprints.prop: a cracked neutral shield, one dropped original monster core, and a dim rescue beacon without text
